Self-hosted GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger from the official gsap npm package.
License notices are preserved in both files.
https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Self-hosted Geist 1.7.2 is in ../fonts with its SIL Open Font License.
The pinned npm packages are development-only sources for these browser assets.
No third-party network request is made by the site.
